findings.title: An agreeing second report of a strength session replaces the whole exercise list: a watch that recognises fewer exercises (or no loads) erases the manual logs; the provider label prefix alone decides it
findings.claimBroken: Claim 6 ("an exact replay or an agreeing second report changes nothing"; "a source label alone never changes a decision"); policy principle 9 (missing data is never negative evidence; duplicates merge); class C08 marked not reproduced by the author
findings.mechanism: normalizeObservations merges a complementary duplicate with previous.actual = {...previous.actual, ...o.actual} when o has the better source rank, so actual.exercises is replaced wholesale; sourceQuality ranks a report WEARABLE_FULL when provider starts with "WEARABLE" or an activityId is present (r6-provenance.mjs lines 14, 105-106). performedInWeek then lists only the surviving exercises as performed.

findings.title: The R7-A exercise-level conflict check skips loads logged in pounds: 80 kg vs 100 lb merges as agreeing and the squat reference drops to 45.5 kg
findings.claimBroken: Claim 6 (contradictory reports are a conflict); strength.loadUnits (pounds are converted at the boundary)
findings.mechanism: exerciseFacts (r6-provenance.mjs line 52) reads a set load only as a bare number or {unit:"KG"}; an LB load yields no value, so the load comparison is skipped. strengthLogs later converts the surviving (better-source) pounds to 45.5 kg and it is adopted below the plan.

class: non-idempotent normalization of the carried ledger
findings.title: A correction of a merged duplicate (correctionOf = the watch report's eventId) is valid in its review and rejected once carried: the session loses every live fact
findings.claimBroken: Claim 6 ("a correction survives being carried into later reviews (normalization of the carried ledger is idempotent)"); residual of C10
findings.mechanism: In the first review byEvent maps the merged duplicate's eventId to the surviving row, so the chain validates. The carried ledger holds only the surviving row (superseded) and the correction; the duplicate's eventId is no longer findable, so the carried correction is INVALID_CORRECTION_CHAIN (r6-provenance.mjs lines 79-80, 109).

findings.title: An exact replay, in a later review, of a report that was merged with a complementary duplicate is quarantined as a conflict and changes the decision
findings.mechanism: The carried row's inputHash is recomputed from the carried (normalized, merged) row and its actual now holds the other source's facts, so the raw replay matches neither and is EVENT_ID_REUSED_WITH_DIFFERENT_FACTS (r6-provenance.mjs lines 88-92).

verdict.reason: The R7-A core mechanisms hold where they were aimed (D53 in every state mode, D54 phase composition, unknown repetitions, legacy hand-over), but the headline invariant fails through neighbouring branches: arrival order of same-week reviews erases a return (01), the return-day boundary skips the entry dose (02), an event-date change leaves race-window and taper days at build doses (03) and the new validation then rejects ordinary proposals (04), and canonical-input stability fails for complementary duplicates, contradictions, pounds, carried corrections and replays (05-09); 10-12 are further state-composition failures. STOP_WHEN ("no known HIGH structural failure of this phase stays open") is not met.

verdict.cycleBoundAssessment: Every blocker is new to the recorded history (not in OPEN_GAPS_R6 or the R7-A class table as found), narrow (one code locus each, listed in mechanism) and runtime-only (the current policy text already states the required behaviour: D49/strengthEntryWeek, proximitySemantics, learning.conflicts, principle 9, loadUnits, resumeAfterDays, gates HOLD). Under the Founder bound a single narrow re-check is therefore admissible; 03/04 share a root and 05/08/09 share the merge path, so the re-check can be scoped to those loci. Ten of the twelve blockers predate R7-A (reproduced on the R6 closure runtime); 04 and 07 are introduced or left partial by the R7-A delta.

nonBlockingRecommendations: Validate rows against exposure.phase as well as the day phase, so a row built under another skeleton is reported as stale rather than as a dose violation
Carry mergedSourceIds as resolvable event ids for correction chains
Compare reps and RIR per exercise in physicalAgrees with the existing within-one convention
Add the cross-review replay, return-then-weekly and event-change-then-proposal sequences to the R7-A regression set
